body.message:
Once you complete the rent and security deposit payment, we will send you the check-in form to fill out. After completing the check-in process, your registration with the building will be processed accordingly.
Please note that our standard check-in time is from 3:00 PM onwards. However, if the unit is ready earlier, we will be happy to accommodate an early check-in whenever possible.

You may contact us anytime between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM, and we will be glad to assist you.
